prompts.title: 3D Couple Miniature
prompts.prompt:
Create a cute premium 3D animated collectible figurine scene of the uploaded couple, using their photo only as the identity reference. Turn them into an adorable husband and wife standing close together on a small round display base. Preserve their recognizable age, facial features, hairstyle, glasses if present, skin tone, and warm loving expressions, but render them in a soft Pixar-style / clay-toy figurine look.

The man stands on the left with a gentle smile, one arm lovingly around the woman’s shoulder, while the woman stands on the right, smiling warmly up at him. Their pose should feel affectionate, calm, and lifelong-romantic.
Dress both subjects in outfits inspired by their own cultural background, keeping the clothing elegant, traditional or semi-traditional, age-appropriate, modest, and visually harmonious. The outfits should feel authentic to the couple’s culture rather than generic Western clothing. For example, use culturally relevant garments, layering, patterns, jewelry, and overall styling that suit the couple naturally, while still keeping the look soft, premium, and simplified for a collectible figurine design. Avoid exaggerated costumes; keep the styling tasteful, warm, and realistic to their background.

Place a vintage black street lamp beside them with a warm glowing lantern. Attach wooden arrow signboards to the lamp post with clean readable engraved text: “MARRIED SINCE”, “HUSBAND NAME”, and “WIFE NAME”. On the front of the round base, add elegant golden text: “ENDLESS ♥ LOVE”.

Set the figurine on a wooden tabletop inside a cozy softly blurred living room, with warm golden lighting, shallow depth of field, premium miniature-diorama feel, soft shadows, smooth toy-like textures, detailed fabric, and realistic lamp glow. Keep the composition centered, heartwarming, clean, and gift-like. Square aspect ratio 1:1.

prompts.title: Contours of Love
prompts.prompt:
Hyper-realistic 3D layered papercut and paper quilling sculpture, showcasing masterful papercraft artistry with a blend of matte and metallic paper textures.
Composition:
Symmetrical dual bust portraits centered in the frame. The male subject on the left and the female subject on the right face each other in close proximity. Their flowing ribbon-like forms merge at the base, elegantly converging into a refined heart shape that forms the lower structure of the sculpture. This heart-shaped base is seamlessly integrated into the design and gently rests on a minimal, smooth wooden stand (light natural wood tone, clean edges, gallery-style plinth).
Subjects & Styling:
Male (Left): Constructed from layered paper forms. Hair & beard (if present in the reference image) is styled in smooth, sculpted waves using thick silver metallic paper strips. His collar/outfit is formed from broad, flowing silver ribbons.
Female (Right): Constructed from delicate layered paper. Hair is an intricate quilled updo made from fine rose-gold metallic paper strips. Her drapery mirrors this style with soft, flowing ribbon forms.
Facial Detail:
Both faces feature subtle, contour-following layered paper cuts that define facial structure (cheeks, jawline, temples), enhancing depth and emphasizing the handcrafted papercut aesthetic.
Pose & Expression:
Clean side-profile views, perfectly aligned face-to-face. Their faces are inches apart, slightly leaning inward. Both subjects are looking directly into each other’s eyes, conveying a soft romantic expression with a sense of intimacy and emotional connection, without physical contact.
Lighting:
Soft, diffused studio lighting to enhance depth and cast subtle, realistic shadows between paper layers.
A warm, glowing backlight is placed precisely in the background between their faces, creating a soft halo and a focal point in the negative space.
Background:
Minimal, seamless matte off-white background for a clean, gallery-style presentation.
Camera & Technical:
Straight-on, eye-level shot, perfectly perpendicular to maintain the flat graphic profile while emphasizing 3D depth.
85mm lens, f/5.6, ISO 100, ultra-sharp focus, 8K resolution, high-end editorial product photography style, crisp detail on paper edges and layered contours.
Style Keywords:
papercraft sculpture, paper quilling art, layered paper design, metallic textures, minimalism, romantic symmetry, ultra-detailed, studio lighting, soft shadows
Aspect ratio 4:5.
No text, no logo, no distortion, no outfit from reference image.

prompts.title: Paper Cutout Pictures
prompts.prompt:
Convert the attached image into a soft, handcrafted paper-cut layered illustration in a papercraft diorama style.
Preserve the original composition and subject identity, but simplify forms into smooth, rounded shapes with cute, stylized proportions. Use minimal facial details (dot eyes, subtle blush, tiny mouth) to create a warm and charming expression.
Construct the scene using stacked paper layers with clear depth separation. Each layer should have clean, crisp cut edges (like precision laser-cut cardstock) and subtle soft shadows between layers to enhance dimensionality.
Place the entire composition inside a 3D recessed shadow box frame (diorama box). The frame should have:
A thick outer border made of matte paper/cardboard
Visible inner depth (inset walls) creating a boxed environment
Soft ambient shadows along the inner edges to emphasize depth
Background layers receding naturally toward the back of the box
The frame should feel like a real handcrafted display piece, not flat—clearly showing physical depth from front to back.
Add a distinct solid white outer outline layer around each main subject, resembling a thick sticker border or white paper backing. This must read as a physical paper layer—not a glow or blur—and should clearly separate the subject from the background.
Detect from reference image and use a correct soft pastel color palette (like: muted blues, gentle greens, warm neutrals), keeping tones balanced, calm, and cohesive.
Lighting should be soft, diffused, and even, with no harsh highlights or contrast—just enough to reveal depth between layers.
Apply a matte, tactile texture across all elements, resembling thick craft paper or foam sheets.
Overall mood: cozy, wholesome, gentle, and storybook-like, with a clean, polished handcrafted aesthetic suitable for modern illustration or children’s book artwork.

prompts.title: Painted Hearts
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly for face and identity reference only. Lock facial identity with the highest priority. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter identity in any way. 

Create a 4k resolution, 4:5 aspect ratio, high-quality digitally rendered watercolour-style portrait of a couple, presented inside a dark walnut wooden frame. The artwork must combine precise digital illustration with the soft, fluid characteristics of traditional watercolor painting.

👥 Subject Composition (Strict — Do Not Modify)
Intimate bust portrait, cropped slightly below mid-chest.
Male positioned on the left, female on the right.
Their upper bodies angled very slightly inward toward each other.
Shoulders gently overlapping, with the female subtly leaning into the male’s shoulder for a natural, connected feel.
Heads placed close together with temples nearly touching.
Both faces turned almost straight toward the camera with only a minimal inward rotation (very subtle 5–10° inward angle).
Chin's level and aligned at a similar height (no exaggerated tilt).
Posture upright but relaxed — not stiff, not exaggerated.
Expressions soft and warm:

Male — calm, subtle, closed-mouth smile.

Female — bright, open smile with gentle warmth.
Eye contact is directed toward the viewer.
No dramatic head tilt. No exaggerated lean. Keep connection natural and balanced.
👕 Adaptive Outfit Detection (Automatic From Reference)
Carefully analyze the uploaded reference image and:
Detect exact clothing type (shirt, blouse, jacket, saree, kurta, suit, casualwear, etc.)

Preserve accurate fabric color, texture, and material type.

Replicate neckline, collar style, sleeve length, layering, and visible accessories.

Maintain realistic folds and garment structure.

Do NOT replace clothing unless explicitly instructed.

Enhance subtle fabric texture slightly for watercolor realism, while keeping authenticity.
🎨 Artistic Style & Watercolor Execution
Medium Simulation:
Blend wet-on-wet soft gradients in background.

Use wet-on-dry precision around facial features.

Allow organic pigment bleeding around edges.

Maintain visible watercolor paper grain texture.
Brushwork Detail:
Fine strokes for eyelashes and individual hair strands.

Controlled detailing around the eyes and lips.

Broad translucent washes for clothing.

Subtle pigment pooling and natural gradient transitions.

Soft watercolour blooms around the outer edges.
Do NOT over-sharpen or make it look like a digital painting — it must feel like genuine watercolor.
🎨 Color Palette (Adaptive + Balanced)
Maintain accurate skin tones from reference.

Use soft warm neutrals (cream, beige, tan) as base tones.

Introduce complementary cool washes when appropriate.

Background should remain light, airy, and minimally dominant.

Avoid heavy contrast or overly saturated tones.
💡 Lighting & Depth
Soft, natural, diffused lighting from slightly above and front-facing.
Gentle highlight across forehead, cheekbones, and nose bridge.
Subtle shadow under the jawline and neck area for depth.
No dramatic side-lighting.
High-key, airy atmosphere.
Enhance depth subtly while maintaining watercolor softness.
🖼 Presentation & Framing
Artwork displayed inside a dark walnut or espresso-finished wooden frame.
Modern flat frame profile with subtle wood grain.
No visible matting.
Art extends near edges for a contemporary full-bleed look.
Visible watercolor paper texture inside frame.
Clean neutral wall mockup presentation.
Frame is visible evenly on all four sides with centred wall alignment.
🔧 Slightly Increased Quality Controls (For Better Results)
Increase fine facial detailing by 15–20% while maintaining watercolor softness.

Improve edge control around eyes and lips for clarity.

Maintain subtle texture contrast between skin and clothing.

Ensure both subjects remain equally sharp and balanced.

prompts.title: Sculpted Souls
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic 8K photograph of a highly detailed, intricately carved oak wood sculpture made from a single continuous slice of polished light-brown oak. The sculpture is formed from a circular tree trunk cross-section, with natural bark preserved around the outer edge and clearly visible organic growth rings radiating from the center. The inner wood surface appears lighter and smoother than the outer bark, showing natural cream-to-light brown oak tones with a refined polished finish. The wood grain must remain natural, continuous, and clearly visible, with precise carving depth that emphasizes craftsmanship, realism, and handmade quality.
Inside the circular wood frame are two hyper-realistic wooden busts carved directly from the same oak material, emerging organically from the inner surface as if revealed from within the tree itself rather than attached separately. The carving integrates seamlessly with the surrounding wood, maintaining natural flow between background and subjects.
Left Subject (Man):

A man whose face closely matches the provided reference image (face match enabled, identity preserved). Facial structure, proportions, age characteristics, and expression remain realistic and natural without stylization or beautification. He has naturally styled hair and a well-groomed beard (if present in the reference), both subtly darker than the surrounding wood tone to enhance depth while remaining fully wooden in appearance. The clothing must match the outfit style and design from the uploaded reference image. Do not change the outfit type. Only apply subtle enhancement in fit and premium refinement while keeping the original style accurate, with fabric details expressed through natural wooden carving. His posture is relaxed and slightly oriented toward the woman, conveying warmth and calm confidence.
Right Subject (Woman):

A woman whose face closely matches the provided reference image (face match enabled, identity preserved). Facial proportions and expression remain soft, calm, and natural. Her natural hair flows smoothly with elegant carved strand direction, integrated naturally into the wood surface. The clothing must match the outfit style and design from the uploaded reference image. Do not change the outfit type. Only apply subtle enhancement in fit and premium refinement while keeping the original style accurate, with fabric details expressed through natural wooden carving. One hand rests naturally on the man’s chest, carved with delicate realism and smooth transitions. Facial planes and hands appear slightly brighter to enhance visibility of fine carving detail while maintaining natural oak realism.
Sculpture Base & Name Plate Detail:

The circular oak sculpture is mounted upright on a minimal wooden display stand made from matching oak material. At the front of the base, a horizontal wooden strip forms an integrated name plate carved from the same piece of wood. The names “Romeo” and “Juliet” are elegantly carved into the wood in a refined handwritten-style carving, with a small carved heart symbol placed between the names. The lettering has natural depth and soft shadowing, appearing sculpted rather than engraved, printed, or painted, maintaining a premium handcrafted aesthetic.
Environment & Background:

The sculpture sits centered on a smooth wooden table within a softly blurred warm indoor environment. The background consists of neutral beige and warm brown tones, suggesting a calm domestic interior while remaining minimal and non-distracting, reinforcing a premium handcrafted lifestyle presentation.
Lighting:

Soft diffused natural daylight enters from the left side, creating gentle highlights across the wood grain and carved facial features. Lighting remains warm, even, and cinematic, enhancing depth, curvature, and natural wood texture without harsh shadows. Subtle ambient fill light preserves detail within deeper carved areas.
Camera & Rendering:

Eye-level composition, centered framing, shallow depth of field, ultra-photorealistic rendering, sharp focus on sculpture details with smooth background bokeh. Premium product photography quality.
Aspect Ratio: 1:1 square composition.

prompts.title: Oak & Infinity
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic 8K photograph of a highly detailed, intricately carved light brown oak sculpture made from a single continuous piece of polished oak wood. The sculpture forms a large elegant heart shape at the top that seamlessly flows into an infinity symbol at the base, symbolizing eternal connection. The wood grain must be natural and clearly visible, with smooth polished edges and fine carving detail that emphasizes craftsmanship and realism.
Inside the heart-shaped frame are two hyper-realistic wooden busts carved from the same light cream-to-light brown oak material:
• On the left: a woman whose face closely matches the uploaded reference image (face match enabled, identity preserved). The facial structure, proportions, age characteristics, and identity must remain accurate to the reference without stylization or alteration. Her hairstyle must also match the reference image correctly — if the reference shows short hair, the sculpture must retain short hair; if the reference shows long hair, it should appear as naturally flowing long hair consistent with the elegant carved style described in this prompt. Hair flow should feel naturally sculpted with realistic strand direction and depth, integrated seamlessly into the wood carving. She wears a carved cream beret and a ribbed turtleneck sweater. Her hands rest naturally together at mid-torso level without holding any object. Her facial expression is calm, soft, and natural, with delicate carving detail and realistic proportions. The facial planes, cheeks, and hands are slightly brighter and more evenly illuminated to enhance visibility of fine carving detail while maintaining natural wood realism. Her hair tone is slightly darker than the surrounding wood for gentle contrast and depth, and the lips carry a very subtle natural warm tint within the wood tone to improve realism without appearing painted or artificial.
• On the right: a man whose face closely matches the uploaded reference image (face match enabled, identity preserved). Facial proportions, expression, and identity must remain faithful to the reference image, maintaining realism and natural carving symmetry. He has naturally styled medium-length hair and wears a carved leather-style jacket layered over a high-neck knit sweater and a textured chunky scarf. His posture is relaxed and slightly oriented toward the woman, with refined facial carving and balanced symmetry. Secondary facial areas and clothing folds are softly brightened to preserve detail while maintaining realistic shadow depth. His hair tone is slightly darker than the base wood tone to enhance dimensional separation and realism, while lips retain a subtle natural tonal variation consistent with carved oak material.
Sculpture Base Design (Important):
The infinity-loop base is thick, smoothly rounded, and structurally integrated into the heart above. The sculpture rests on an oval wooden platform made from the same oak material. The names “Emily” and “Jack” are beautifully carved directly into the front-facing surfaces of the infinity loops, positioned symmetrically and naturally following the curve of the wood. The lettering appears as part of the wood design itself — elegantly carved, refined, and polished, with subtle depth and soft shadowing so the names feel handcrafted and integrated rather than added or embossed.
Environment & Background:
The sculpture sits centered on a smooth wooden table. A small potted succulent in a minimal ceramic pot sits to the side. The background is a softly blurred warm domestic interior with neutral beige tones, suggesting a sofa and window light, maintaining a clean lifestyle aesthetic.
Lighting (Matched to Reference Image):
Soft diffused natural daylight entering from the left side, creating gentle highlights along the curved heart frame and subtle shadows within the infinity loops. Lighting is warm, even, and cinematic, emphasizing wood texture and depth without harsh contrast. Soft ambient fill light maintains detail in facial carvings while preserving natural shadow gradients. No dramatic studio lighting — calm, realistic indoor daylight mood.
Camera & Rendering:
Eye-level composition, centered framing, shallow depth of field, ultra-photorealistic rendering, sharp focus on sculpture details with smooth background bokeh, premium product photography quality.
Aspect Ratio: 1:1 square composition.
